In the most recent financial year, RF recorded a significant decline in profitability and operating cash flow alongside substantial capital expenditure requirements. The company has demonstrated an inconsistent payout pattern historically and did not distribute any dividends in both 2023 and 2024.

While the company maintains a strong equity base, elevated inflation and reduced operating cash generation limit immediate distribution capacity. Given that dividends are already suspended and cash preservation remains a priority, the company is expected to maintain its zero-dividend stance in the upcoming financial year.
